Kashmiri Pandits Attend Kheer Bhawani Fair Amid Calls for Return

The annual Kheer Bhawani Mela saw Kashmiri Pandits gather at the shrine, expressing a desire to return to their homes. Political leaders addressed the attendees, with some urging the community to forget the past and return with dignity, while others noted the desire of people in the valley for their return. The event highlights ongoing sentiments and political discussions surrounding the Kashmiri Pandit community.
